# eureka

`eureka` is a command-line tool that lets you quickly record an idea using your preferred editor and have that idea stored in a git-backed ideas repository.

Think of it as a very quick way to capture short notes: run the command, write your idea, and it will be saved to your ideas repository so you can revisit it later.

![demo](assets/demo.gif)

## Usage

Run the command with no arguments to capture a new idea. The first time you run it you will be asked to configure the path to your ideas repository.

View stored ideas with the view flag:

```sh
$ eureka --view
```

### Flags

```sh
    --clear-config    Clear your stored configuration
-v, --view            View ideas with your $PAGER environment variable (falls back to less)
```

### Recommended alias

An easy-to-remember alias is `idea`:

**Zsh**

```sh
echo 'alias idea="eureka"' >> ~/.zshrc
```

**Bash**

```sh
echo 'alias idea="eureka"' >> ~/.bashrc
```

**Fish**

```sh
echo 'alias idea="eureka"' >> ~/.config/fish/config.fish
```

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, code)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, stderr)

        self.config.write_bytes(raw if raw is not None else json.dumps({'repo':str(self.repo)}).encode())

        self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(p.stderr, b'')
        self.assertIn(b'Usage: ' + EXE.name.encode() + b' [OPTIONS]\n', p.stdout)

                self.assertEqual(p.returncode, 2)
                self.assertEqual(p.stdout, b'')

                self.assertTrue(p.stderr.endswith(b"For more information, try '--help'.\n"))

        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), ('{"repo":"' + str(self.repo) + '"}').encode())
        self.assertFalse(self.repo.exists())  # Setup records a path, without validating the repository.

        rejected = b'\x1b[0m\x1b[31mPath must be absolute\n\x1b[0m'
        self.assert_result(p, BANNER + PATH_PROMPT*3 + rejected + PATH_PROMPT + rejected +
                           PATH_PROMPT + b'First time setup complete. Happy ideation!\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), b'{"repo":"/tmp/idea notes/"}')

                           b' ERROR eureka > stream did not contain valid UTF-8\n')
        self.assertTrue(self.config.parent.exists())
        self.assertFalse(self.config.exists())

    def test_view_missing_config_does_not_setup(self):
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view'), stderr=MISSING)
        self.assertFalse(self.config.parent.exists())

    def test_clear_config_precedence(self):
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--clear-config'), stderr=MISSING)
        self.configure(raw=b'invalid JSON')
        keep = self.config.parent / 'keep.txt'
        keep.write_text('keep')
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view', '--clear-config'))
        self.assertFalse(self.config.exists())
        self.assertEqual(keep.read_text(), 'keep')
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--clear-config'), stderr=MISSING)

    def test_invalid_config_reports_for_view_and_resets_for_capture(self):
        self.configure(raw=b'{')
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view'), stderr=b' ERROR eureka > EOF while parsing an object at line 1 column 1\n')
        p = self.run_tool(data=b'/tmp/replacement\n')
        self.assert_result(p, BANNER + PATH_PROMPT + b'First time setup complete. Happy ideation!\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), b'{"repo":"/tmp/replacement"}')

        for raw, message in [

            (b'null', 'invalid type: null, expected struct Config at line 1 column 4'),
            (b'{"repo":12}', 'invalid type: integer `12`, expected path string at line 1 column 10'),
            (b'{"repo":[]}', 'invalid type: sequence, expected path string at line 1 column 8'),
            (b'{"repo":"a","repo":"b"}', 'duplicate field `repo` at line 1 column 18'),
            (b' ', 'EOF while parsing a value at line 1 column 1'),
            (b'\xff', 'stream did not contain valid UTF-8'),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(raw=raw):
                self.configure(raw=raw)
                self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view'), stderr=(' ERROR eureka > ' + message + '\n').encode())

        p = self.run_tool(data=b'Summary\n')
        self.assert_result(p, PROMPT, b" ERROR eureka > failed to resolve path '': No such file or directory; class=Os (2); code=NotFound (-3)\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.config.read_bytes(), b'')

        self.configure()
        text = b'Any notes\n\xff\x00last line'

        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('-v'), text)
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('-v', PAGER='false'))
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('-v', PAGER='cat -n'), stderr=MISSING)

        self.repo.mkdir()
        (self.repo / 'README.md').write_text('notes')
        raw_path = str(self.repo) + '//'
        self.configure(raw=json.dumps({'repo': raw_path}).encode())
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view', PAGER='echo'), (raw_path + '/README.md\n').encode())

        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--view', PAGER='echo'), stderr=MISSING)

        (self.repo / 'untracked.txt').write_text('not staged\n')

        self.assertEqual(self.git('show', 'HEAD:staged.txt'), b'already staged\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.git('status', '--porcelain'), b'?? untracked.txt\n')

    def test_local_bare_push(self):
        self.repository()
        remote = self.home / 'remote.git'
        subprocess.check_call(['git', 'init', '--bare', '-q', str(remote)], env=self.env)
        self.git('remote', 'add', 'origin', str(remote))

        self.assertEqual(self.git('rev-parse', 'origin/main'), target)

        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--clear-config', RUST_LOG='off'))
        expected = b' DEBUG eureka > Running with options: EurekaOptions { clear_config: true, view: false }\n' + MISSING
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--clear-config', RUST_LOG='debug'), stderr=expected)
        self.assert_result(self.run_tool('--clear-config', RUST_LOG='other=debug'))

    unittest.main()
